name: cache-warmer
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm: just before it would expire, re-sends the cached prefix as a silent fork.

leadSeconds.title: Lead time (seconds)
leadSeconds.description: How long before expiry the warm-up request goes out. It only has to cover the 5s check interval plus request latency.

maxWarmups.title: Max warm-ups while idle
maxWarmups.description: 0 (default) stops at break-even: once the pings would cost more than rebuilding the cache. Any other number is a hard cap on consecutive pings.

showStatus.title: Show status line countdown
showStatus.description: Show how long the cache stays warm in the status line.
